about_the_game:
Embark on an enthralling journey through the intricate world of One Dash Star, a physics-based puzzle game that will challenge your dexterity and strategic thinking. In this captivating adventure, you'll guide a marble towards its celestial destination, navigating through a series of increasingly intricate levels filled with fixed and moving obstacles.

The gameplay of One Dash Star is deceptively simple yet undeniably engaging. With a simple click and drag motion of your mouse or a flick of the joystick, you'll trace a path for the marble, guiding it with precision and finesse. Your objective is clear: deliver the marble safely to its designated star. But achieving this goal won't be easy. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter a diverse array of obstacles that will test your focus, reflexes, and strategic thinking.


Intuitive and Addictive Gameplay: Master the art of guiding the marble with simple yet precise mouse or controller movements.

Diverse and Challenging Levels: Each level presents a unique set of obstacles, demanding strategic thinking and quick reflexes.

Vivid and Vibrant Graphics: Immerse yourself in a captivating world adorned with colorful and engaging visuals.

Upbeat and Motivating Soundtrack: Experience an exhilarating soundtrack that complements the intense gameplay.

Suitable for All Ages: Enjoy a fun and challenging experience that appeals to players of all ages and skill levels.
